summary: A UCSF parking structure at 1670 Owens Street in Mission Bay, on Owens Street opposite Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay, with entrance access from C Street; a real-estate assessor-data aggregator gives its year built as 2010, but no UCSF announcement or primary construction record was found.

milestones.text: Parking structure completed (year built, per a real-estate assessor-data aggregator; no UCSF or Regents construction record was found for this specific address)

costs.what: SF Department of Building Inspection permit #200801243180's revised construction-cost valuation for the 6-story, 823-space parking garage (the permit's initial filed estimate was $17,900,000); no UCSF or Regents primary source names a cost for this garage

open_questions: No primary UCSF or Regents-of-the-University-of-California source was found dating this specific garage. This project's own established finding for Mission Bay's UCSF buildings is that UCSF is state land and not carried in DataSF's Assessor secured tax roll (no blklot to join); the 2010 year-built figure here comes from PropertyShark, a third-party real-estate aggregator, not from DataSF or a UCSF announcement -- treat it as approximate and secondary-sourced, not UCSF-confirmed.

Searched UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings agenda items for a 'Mission Bay' parking structure at Owens Street or matching this garage's ~820-874 space, ~250,000 gsf, nine-level profile (the November 2003 item for the separate Building 23B/Third Street Garage has very similar statistics, so a same-era Owens Street garage item likely exists but was not located in this pass); WRNS Studio's own award-winning 'Mission Bay Parking Structure'/'UCSF Parking Structure' project (2010 AIA SF Citation Award, cited elsewhere as 'Mission Bay Block 27 Parking Structure', 1,420 spaces on seven floors) was considered but not used here, since its capacity and floor count don't match this record's OSM tagging (5 levels) and its address was never confirmed to be 1670 Owens -- left unlinked rather than guessed.

A ~820-space capacity figure appears in parking aggregators (ParkChirp, Waze/Parkopedia) but is not independently confirmed by a UCSF or SF YIMBY source -- the same caveat already recorded in this record's own geometry file -- so it is left out of facts here as well.
No architect or design-build team was identified for this specific address.

2026-09-22 pass: another candidate was checked and ruled out. UCSF's William J. Rutter Community Center (Block 21B, architect Ricardo Legorreta with MBT/Perkins+Will, per a May 2000 Regents design-approval item and Forell/Elsesser's own project page) has its own, separately-addressed parking garage -- confirmed via UCSF-affiliated contact pages and parking directories to be at 1625 Owens St, not this record's 1670 Owens St. These are two distinct structures a few hundred feet apart; the Rutter Center's own garage material does not apply to this record.
